investigation_notes.Playbook Used: Azure Network Security Group Modification Triage
investigation_notes.Description: An Azure Network Security Group rule was deleted (SECURITYRULES/DELETE) on NSG nsg-tallinn-prod-01 in resource group rg-baltic-prod-connectivity. The action was performed by markus.tamm@globalcorp.ee, a Contributor, from 145.14.39.114 in Tallinn, Estonia, at 09:15 UTC. The change affects production network controls and could alter access exposure; given the potential impact and the user's role, this activity warrants HP investigation.
